name: Question 5
problem:
Given that the differential equation

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-3\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+2y=20\operatorname{cos}⁡2x
$$

$$
y(x)=A{e}^{x}+B{e}^{2x}-3\operatorname{sin}⁡2x-\operatorname{cos}⁡2x,
$$

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-3\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+2y=20\operatorname{cos}⁡2x,\,y(0)=3,\,{y}^{′}(0)=0.
$$

Question 5
?

Given that the differential equation d2ydx2−3dydx+2y=20cos⁡2x

has the general solution y(x)=Aex+Be2x−3sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x,

solve the initial value problem d2ydx2−3dydx+2y=20cos⁡2x,y(0)=3,y′(0)=0.

a
y=6e2x−3sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x
b
y=e2x−3sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x
c
y=5ex−e2x−3sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x
d
y=2ex+2e2x−3sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x
e
y=−3ex−3sin⁡2x−cos⁡2x
